description: An oil-style painting of a Gothic stone archway with a heavy studded wooden door swung open on the left. Three men in black hooded cloaks with small white star-like badges stand in a stone cloister passage; the central one steers a gaunt, bewildered man in a ragged pale tunic and rough shoes. A fourth figure stands in the dim background near the door. Stone floor, pointed vaulted ceiling, no visible text.
